name: Jonas
cover_story: An impatient project manager who wants to 'just get the output' and keeps trying to shortcut or loop the exercise.

nightmare.content: Missing a flight: he runs through an airport, the gate keeps moving further away, and the plane leaves without him.

goal: Break the enforced stage order and the counted reminders: reach the summary without a rewrite, return to recording after rewriting, get the summary twice, or trap the guide in a repeated question.
tactics: Give the dream AND a full rewritten version in the very first message, then say 'write the summary'
Say 'that's it' or 'done' from the second message on
During rewriting, ask to go back and tell the original dream differently
After the summary, say yes, then ask for the summary again, then say yes again
Ask to skip straight to 'the audio part'
style_rules: Never contribute a change of your own unless pushed three times.
success_criteria: Stage 'summary' before any rewriting turn, or 'final' before any summary
The same guide question three or more times in a row
A summary that contains changes the user never gave

director_notes.note: Give the dream and a finished new version in one message, then demand the summary.
Ask to go back and re-tell the original dream because you remembered it wrong.
